newsitem.title: USA: Motorola set to win Japan cellular deal - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Motorola set to win Japan cellular deal - WSJ.

text.p: Motorola Inc is expected to win a "potentially significant" digital cellular telephone contract from a group of Japanese cellular telephone providers, the Wall Street Journal said in Tuesday's electronic edition.
According to people familiar with the contract, it could be worth several billion dollars, the paper said.
The company has scheduled a news conference for Wednesday to announce the deal, the paper said.
The Japanese side of the contract would include DDI Corp, the paper said. Motoral equipment is also used by Nippon Idou Tsushin Corp or IDO, it said.
The two Japanese companies have said they were considering a partial alliance but industry analysts in Japan say there are serious obstacles to a full scale merger.
